trophies.guide: The last box you will ever tick. It pops the moment the other 54 are done, so treat this page as the checklist: finish the story, clean up the stranger strands, grind the activities, then sweep the collectibles for 100%. Nothing here needs a second playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is unmissable: play through it and the trophy lands at the end. Use it to learn the driving and the swap between Jason and Lucia.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1 to its end. Nothing optional is needed for this one, but do meditate at Jason's house while you are still here (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story progress only: keep the main missions moving and the trophy comes with the chapter's final cutscene.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Same rule as the other chapter trophies: main missions only, no side work required.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale: push the story missions and it unlocks with the chapter end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It unlocks the moment the credits roll; no extra objective is attached, so just finish the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. A story mission, so it comes naturally if you keep playing the main path; no special preparation needed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. One of the big set-piece story missions: play it through and the trophy follows the mission complete screen.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. Story mission trophy: keep following the main missions and it unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. Another story mission trophy; nothing to set up in advance, just finish the mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Story mission: finish the takedown and the trophy pops with the mission results.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named story-mission trophies: complete the operation and it is yours.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The 100% checklist is the whole game: story, all eight stranger strands, every activity, the races, the collectibles and full exploration of Leonida. Follow the roadmap on this page in order and save this for last — it pops right before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunts accumulate across the entire game, so you do not need to farm one spot. Keep driving, take jumps when they appear, and the 250 will arrive on its own over a normal playthrough.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. One attempt each is enough: you do not have to win, finish, or score anything, so just sample them and move on.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 shooting-range challenges and every one needs a gold medal. Practice each range first to learn its rhythm, then chase gold one challenge at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. The courses differ but the flying does not, so once you can win one cleanly you can win them all — work through the map location by location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Twenty different races need a win each. Vary the vehicle class and the route: the count is by race, not by win, so a second win on the same course adds nothing. Work down the race list and the trophy follows the twentieth new win.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal runs the fishing challenges, and this one is a straight duel: out-fish him. Take your time on the cast and the reel — the challenge is about patience, not gear.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Pick any arcade cabinet and finish a game on it. It does not matter which cabinet or what score you post — one completed game is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand ends with Puff Puff Pass. Follow his stranger missions to the last one and finish it; the trophy is tied to that final mission, not to anything you do along the way.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand runs to a final mission of its own. Play his stranger missions in order until the last one appears, then complete it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand ends with his final mission. Work through his stranger missions until the last one unlocks and finish it.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger mission strands need completing across Leonida. The five named contacts with their own final-mission trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of them; the rest are stranger encounters scattered around the state — talk to everyone who offers a mission and the count fills on its own.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends with his final mission. Follow his stranger missions to the end and finish the last one.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's final mission is literally called Spin On This. Play his strand through to it and complete it.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable one. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida and one sits at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — meditate there early, while you still can, because it is the one spot guides flag as possibly missable. After that, the rest can be visited any time: sit at each spot until the prompt completes, and the trophy pops at the eighteenth.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants a unique animal hunted. Track the animal he names — it will not be a common spawn — and bring it down; the hunt itself is the trophy, so one clean kill is enough.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Three full collectible card sets are needed. Cards are hidden all over Leonida — in shops, hideouts and mission spots. Pick them up as you travel and keep an eye on the set lists; three complete sets is the goal.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK machines are scattered across Leonida. Use one whenever you pass it — a hundred sounds like a lot, but it adds up fast if you make it a habit at every stop.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Fifty of the eighty challenges need completing. Challenges cover almost everything — driving, combat, exploration — so pick the fifty that suit how you already play instead of forcing the hardest ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then escape. Keep moving and break line of sight until the stars fade — the escape counts only if your partner is still with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a short route between three close shops, hit them in quick succession, and do not let the heat drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you sit in counts, so drive something different whenever you get the chance — parked cars, traffic, mission vehicles all add to the count.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies inside a single Combat Focus. Wait for a tight group before you trigger it, and pick a spot with cover nearby — five in one window needs the enemies bunched, not spread out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is the airport, and the trophy is about leaving it off-schedule. Get to the airfield and make your own departure; the trophy triggers once you are out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks sit at guarded military spots, so expect a fight on the way in and a chase on the way out. Once you are in the driver's seat and clear of the base, the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, watch the sightlines, and get out before anyone raises the alarm — one spotted guard or camera and the attempt is wasted.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big jobs: plan the entry, grab the cash, and have your escape route ready before you go in — five clean getaways is the whole ask.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the city: hit one, take the cash, and escape clean — the trophy needs the getaway, not just the robbery.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so this one is mostly patience: drive every road, visit every named place, and the last undiscovered area pops the trophy.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs. Each gang runs its own rackets; hit one operation per gang and the trophy counts the set, not the haul.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — reports say this pops from enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide has verified it yet. Try the beach bars if you are passing; do not go out of your way until it is confirmed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — reports say it involves smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, but the exact trigger is not verified. No confirmed method yet; check back after the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play the objective through. Guides describe it as a follow-through job at the alley involving its three key valuables; finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out the strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train regularly with each of them — it is a slow grind, so fold it into your normal play rather than saving it for the end.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 Criminal Profile actions. These are the small criminal acts the profile tracks — they add up across every session, so just play the criminal life and the count climbs. There is no single action to farm; volume is the method.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the description ('Second time's the charm') hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no method is verified. Do not chase this one until a guide confirms the trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED and hidden — nothing verified about this one at all. The description ('What the hell just happened?') suggests a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida, but no guide has pinned it down. Leave it until the community finds it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — KeenGamer reports it as a melee drive-by elimination, but the precise method is not confirmed. Try a melee strike from a moving vehicle if the chance comes up, and do not grind it until the trigger is verified.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from the bigger robberies, so this one follows naturally once you are hitting vaults and trucks — keep laundering as you earn and the quarter-million arrives.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars, food — every dollar at any shop counts. It adds up fast over a full playthrough, so do not save it for last; spend as you go.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages. Garages unlock as you progress and cost real money, so buy each one when it appears rather than waiting — eight owned is the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles with the Scooter Bros app. Drive a vehicle you want to keep, open the app, and register it — ten registrations, any ten vehicles, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: On the Spot
